the 48 laws of power for women

the rules you were never taught

move quietly when the stakes
are high

let them underestimate you.

don't beg for a seat at the table

build your own.
hold eye contact a little longer

protect your solitude

that's where you recharge.

never stop learning

i read one short lesson every
morning.
